exposure: Robson's ten group classification system for cesarean sections
cohort: 950 pregnant women admitted for delivery at two teaching hospitals affiliated with Jundishapur University of Medical Sciences, Ahvaz, Iran.
finding: The highest contributors to the overall cesarean section rate were repeat cesareans (Group 5), pregnancies beyond 41 weeks (Group 10), and nulliparous women with single cephalic pregnancies at term (Group 1).
